info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Guarantee Inquiry API
info.description: The Bank Guarantee Inquiry API allows users to access detailed information about specific bank guarantees within a trade banking context. This endpoint supports queries for retrieving guarantee data based on a unique identifier, enabling businesses to verify terms, conditions, and status. Typical consumers include banking professionals, financial analysts, and compliance teams who require accurate and timely information for decision-making and reporting. This API simplifies the management and oversight of bank guarantee operations, fostering transparency and efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific bank guarantee identified by its unique ID. Utilize this to access all relevant data associated with the bank guarantee.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested bank guarantee details.
